external_source.article: Synthesis reveals that island species-area relationships emerge from processes beyond passive sampling

intended_study_family: within-archipelago relative source isolation x stepping-stone topology

eligibility_rule: complete island latitude/longitude and positive area
>=9 focal islands having at least one strictly larger-area source island
>=3 islands with positive response-independent minimax stepping-stone gain
predictor-only five-column matrix full rank: intercept + z(log area) + z(log direct larger-source distance) + z(topology gain) + interaction

incident.trigger: GitHub fetch_commit on the external repository commit was used to obtain response-file identities, but the commit API response included file patches/content for changed response matrices.

scientific_design_lesson.source_definition: for focal island i, source candidates are islands in the same independent study with strictly larger land area
scientific_design_lesson.direct_source_isolation: great-circle distance from focal island to nearest larger-area island
scientific_design_lesson.stepping_stone_bottleneck: minimum possible largest inter-island step from focal island to any larger-area source through the complete island network
scientific_design_lesson.topology_gain: log1p(direct source distance) - log1p(minimax bottleneck distance)
scientific_design_lesson.intended_estimand: within-archipelago topology_gain x relative direct-source-isolation interaction, aggregated with equal archipelago weight
scientific_design_lesson.reason: separates within-archipelago topology from between-archipelago absolute isolation/history

terminal_rule: Do not freeze or run a prospective confirmatory protocol on any N10/N20 response matrix from this source. Do not use its response direction to choose thresholds, studies, taxa, topology definition or model. Preserve only the response-blind metadata feasibility lesson.
